reviews.text: It might be okay to go there for a vaccination, but I wouldn't recommend it for medical treatment. The equipment is so old that they can't even take a proper X-ray. Furthermore, they told me that there was no fluid buildup in my chest on the X-ray, but when I had an X-ray at another hospital later, there was fluid buildup. When I told them about this, they said there was fluid buildup from the time of the first X-ray. Didn't you say there wasn't any? I can't trust them.

I have two cats here for treatment, and the vet talks to them while examining them and, most importantly, treats them with such affection.

Previously, I went to a hospital with mostly dogs, and my cats felt out of place in the waiting room due to their constant meowing. However, this cat hospital has short waiting times, quick and thorough treatments, and a very welcoming atmosphere. I love it!

I don't even want to give it a single star.
I went to the hospital as instructed and gave my cat the medicine, but he still passed away.
He didn't get better after starting the medicine, so I consulted them, but they told me to keep an eye on him until he finished the medicine, and during that time his condition rapidly worsened.
When I contacted them, they told me I should have brought him in sooner, and I was so angry and sad I was speechless.
I will never forgive this hospital, or myself for not trying other hospitals.
